preconditions.description: The number of elements in the array is between 2 and 200,000.
The constant m is at least 1.
The number of subarrays k is at least 2.
The product of m and k is less than or equal to n.
Each element in the array is between -1,000,000,000 and 1,000,000,000.

postconditions.description: The maximum possible sum of the beauties of the subarrays is calculated correctly.
The number of partition indices is exactly k-1.

postconditions.expression: 1 <= partition_indices[i] < partition_indices[i+1] < n for i in range(k-2)
postconditions.description: Partition indices are strictly increasing and within the valid range.

postconditions.expression: all(a[i] in subarray for subarray in subarrays for i in range(n))
postconditions.description: All elements of the array belong to exactly one subarray.

postconditions.expression: all(len(subarray) >= m for subarray in subarrays)
postconditions.description: Each subarray has at least m elements.
